book: Please accept our sincere apologies for the downtime your team experienced today.

family.ex: Battery failure caused 38 minutes of downtime in the server room.
family.ar: عطل البطاريات عمل 38 دقيقة توقف في أوضة السيرفرات.
family.ex2: Production systems were offline the whole time.
family.ar2: أنظمة الإنتاج كانت فاصلة طول الوقت ده.

family.ex: The ERP server is down, so nobody can issue invoices.
family.ar: سيرفر الـ‎ERP‎ واقع، فمحدش يقدر يطلّع فواتير.
family.ex2: IT is working on it now.

family.ex: If the UPS fails, all servers go down at once.
family.ar: لو الـ‎UPS‎ وقع، كل السيرفرات بتقع مرة واحدة.
family.ex2: That is why battery health is so important.
family.ar2: عشان كده صحة البطاريات مهمة جدًا.

syn.note: power or network is lost; downtime is how long systems stop
syn.ex: The power outage lasted two hours in 6th of October City.
syn.ar: انقطاع الكهربا استمر ساعتين في مدينة 6 أكتوبر.
syn.ex2: Our UPS and generator covered the load.

syn.note: a short break in service; softer word
syn.ex: There will be a short interruption during the UPS transfer.
syn.ar: هيبقى فيه انقطاع قصير وقت نقل الـ‎UPS‎.
syn.ex2: It will last less than one minute.

syn.note: systems are switched off, planned or unplanned
syn.ex: A planned shutdown is needed to replace the battery string.
syn.ar: محتاجين إيقاف مخطط عشان نغيّر صف البطاريات.
syn.ex2: We will do it on Saturday morning.

ant.ex: Our goal is 99.9% uptime for your data centre.
ant.ar: هدفنا إن الداتا سنتر بتاعكم يفضل شغال 99.9% من الوقت.
ant.ex2: Battery monitoring helps us reach it.

steps.ex: Users saw a brief interruption when the switch restarted.
steps.ar: اليوزرز لاحظوا انقطاع قصير لما السويتش عمل ريستارت.

steps.ex: The faulty module caused five hours of downtime.
steps.ar: الموديول البايظ عمل خمس ساعات توقف.

steps.ex: A major outage hit the whole plant for a full day.
steps.ar: انقطاع كبير ضرب المصنع كله يوم كامل.
steps.ex2: Both the grid and the generator failed.

ctx: The UPS did not hold the load, and the server room had 38 minutes of downtime. Please accept our sincere apologies.
ctx_ar: الـ‎UPS‎ ماشالش الحمل، وأوضة السيرفرات وقفت 38 دقيقة. من فضلك اقبل اعتذارنا الصادق.

quiz.s: The ERP server is ___, so nobody can issue invoices.
quiz.ar: سيرفر الـ‎ERP‎ واقع، فمحدش يقدر يطلّع فواتير.

quiz.s: Our goal is 99.9% ___ for your data centre.
quiz.ar: هدفنا إن الداتا سنتر بتاعكم يفضل شغال 99.9% من الوقت.

quiz.s: A planned ___ is needed to replace the battery string.
quiz.ar: محتاجين إيقاف مخطط عشان نغيّر صف البطاريات.

book: Our engineers are on site now and have already started the investigation.

family.ex: We are investigating why the battery alarm was not escalated.
family.ex2: We will share the results by Sunday.

family.ex: Our investigation found three weak blocks in the battery string.
family.ar: الفحص بتاعنا لقى تلات بلوكات ضعيفة في صف البطاريات.
family.ex2: They dropped below the minimum voltage.
family.ar2: الجهد بتاعهم نزل تحت الحد الأدنى.

family.ex: The insurance investigator asked for our incident report.
family.ar: محقق التأمين طلب تقرير الحادثة بتاعنا.
family.ex2: He needs it to process the client's claim.

syn.note: physical check on site; investigation looks for the cause
syn.ex: During the inspection, we found loose battery cables.
syn.ar: أثناء الكشف، لقينا كابلات بطاريات سايبة.
syn.ex2: We tightened them before closing the cabinet.

syn.note: short and simple; common in quick updates
syn.ex: Our initial check shows a problem in the battery string.
syn.ar: الكشف المبدئي بتاعنا بيبيّن إن فيه مشكلة في صف البطاريات.

syn.note: look again at data or a process, often by managers
syn.ex: We will review our escalation process after this incident.
syn.ar: هنراجع طريقة التصعيد عندنا بعد الحادثة دي.
syn.ex2: Critical alarms will go to the Service Manager.

steps.ex: A quick check showed the UPS running on mains.
steps.ar: كشف سريع بيّن إن الـ‎UPS‎ شغال على الكهربا العمومية.

steps.ex: A full inspection of the battery room takes two hours.
steps.ar: الكشف الكامل على أوضة البطاريات بياخد ساعتين.
steps.ex2: We test every block one by one.

steps.ex: The client asked for a full investigation and an RCA report.
steps.ex2: Management wants to know who missed the warning.
steps.ar2: الإدارة عايزة تعرف مين اللي فوّت التحذير.

ctx: Our engineers are on site and have already started the investigation. We will send the full incident report by Sunday.
ctx_ar: مهندسينا في الموقع وبدأوا الفحص فعلًا. هنبعت تقرير الحادثة الكامل قبل الحد.

quiz.s: We are ___ why the alarm was not escalated.
The insurance ___ asked for our report.
The client asked for a ___ and an RCA report.

book: I understand that the batteries were old, but we expected NPS to warn us more strongly before this happened.

family.ex: Please warn the client before we switch the UPS to bypass.
family.ar: من فضلك نبّه العميل قبل ما نحوّل الـ‎UPS‎ على الـ‎bypass‎.
family.ex2: Their servers will have no backup for ten minutes.
family.ar2: السيرفرات بتاعتهم هتبقى من غير باك أب عشر دقايق.

family.ex: The UPS gave a low battery warning last week.
family.ar: الـ‎UPS‎ طلّع تحذير بطارية ضعيفة الأسبوع اللي فات.
family.ex2: Nobody acted on it, and the batteries failed.

family.ex: The monitoring system works as an early-warning tool for weak blocks.
family.ar: نظام المراقبة بيشتغل كأداة إنذار مبكر للبلوكات الضعيفة.
family.ex2: It sends an alarm before a block fails.
family.ar2: بيبعت إنذار قبل ما البلوك يقع.

syn.note: quick message about a problem now, often automatic
syn.ex: The system will alert your team by SMS.
syn.ex2: Our engineers get the same alert.

syn.note: formal; give official information, not always about danger
syn.ex: Please notify us 48 hours before the planned shutdown.
syn.ar: من فضلك بلّغنا قبل الإيقاف المخطط بـ48 ساعة.
syn.ex2: We need time to arrange an engineer.

syn.note: formal email word: inform or recommend
syn.ex: We advise you to replace the full battery string.
syn.ex2: The blocks are five years old.

steps.ex: Our last visit report only mentioned the old batteries.
steps.ar: تقرير آخر زيارة ذكر البطاريات القديمة وخلاص.
steps.ex2: It was just one line at the end.

steps.ex: We warned the client twice that the batteries were weak.
steps.ar: نبّهنا العميل مرتين إن البطاريات ضعيفة.
steps.ex2: We sent emails in June and August.

steps.ex: We should have raised the alarm with your management.
steps.ar: كان المفروض ندق جرس الإنذار عند الإدارة بتاعتكم.
steps.ex2: A short email to IT was not enough.

ctx: The batteries were five years old. We should have warned you more strongly before the power cut.
ctx_ar: البطاريات كان عمرها خمس سنين. كان المفروض ننبّهكم بشكل أقوى قبل ما الكهربا تقطع.

quiz.s: The UPS gave a low battery ___ last week.
quiz.ar: الـ‎UPS‎ طلّع تحذير بطارية ضعيفة الأسبوع اللي فات.

quiz.s: Please ___ us 48 hours before the shutdown.
quiz.ar: من فضلك بلّغنا قبل الإيقاف بـ48 ساعة.

quiz.s: The monitoring system works as an ___ tool.
quiz.ar: نظام المراقبة بيشتغل كأداة إنذار مبكر.

book: Please send us a full incident report with the root cause and your corrective actions within 48 hours.

family.ex: Please correct the tax number on invoice 3315.
family.ar: من فضلك صحّح الرقم الضريبي على فاتورة 3315.
family.ex2: The ETA portal rejected it this morning.

family.ex: We will send a correction to the incident report today.
family.ex2: The time of the transfer was wrong.

family.ex: Corrective actions include replacing the weak blocks and adding monitoring.
family.ar: الإجراءات التصحيحية بتشمل تغيير البلوكات الضعيفة وإضافة مراقبة.
family.ex2: Both will be done before the end of October.

family.ex: The generator started correctly, but the batteries failed first.
family.ar: المولد اشتغل صح، بس البطاريات وقعت الأول.
family.ex2: So the servers lost power for a few seconds.

syn.note: formal; work done to fix a problem
syn.ex: Remedial work on the cabling will take one day.
syn.ex2: We will do it on Friday when the office is closed.

syn.note: simple everyday verb for the same idea
syn.ex: We fixed the root cause, not only the symptom.
syn.ar: صلّحنا السبب الأساسي، مش العَرَض بس.
syn.ex2: The weak blocks are already replaced.

ctx: Please find attached our incident report. It explains the root cause and the corrective actions we have already taken.
ctx_ar: مرفق تقرير الحادثة بتاعنا. بيشرح السبب الأساسي والإجراءات التصحيحية اللي عملناها خلاص.

quiz.s: Please ___ the tax number on the invoice.
quiz.ar: من فضلك صحّح الرقم الضريبي على الفاتورة.

quiz.s: ___ actions include replacing the weak blocks.
quiz.ar: الإجراءات التصحيحية بتشمل تغيير البلوكات الضعيفة.

quiz.s: The generator started ___, but the batteries failed first.
quiz.ar: المولد اشتغل صح، بس البطاريات وقعت الأول.

book: Please find attached our revised quotation Q-2025-244 with a 10% discount on the 40 battery blocks.

family.ex: We revised the quotation after the client asked for a discount.
family.ar: عدّلنا عرض السعر بعد ما العميل طلب خصم.

family.ex: Please find attached our revised quotation Q-2025-244.
family.ex2: It now includes battery monitoring for six months.
family.ar2: دلوقتي بيشمل مراقبة البطاريات لمدة ست شهور.

family.ex: This is revision 2 of the solar station layout.
family.ar: دي النسخة المعدّلة رقم 2 من تصميم المحطة الشمسية.
family.ex2: We moved the inverters closer to the panels.

syn.note: newest version with fresh info; very common
syn.ex: Here is the updated delivery schedule for the batteries.
syn.ex2: Two blocks will arrive one day early.

syn.note: formal; a change to a contract or official document
syn.ex: Please sign the amended contract with the new response time.
syn.ar: من فضلك امضي العقد المعدّل بوقت الاستجابة الجديد.

syn.note: a small change in numbers, like price or settings
syn.ex: We adjusted the deceleration time to 15 seconds.
syn.ex2: The drive has not tripped since.

ant.ex: The original quotation did not include installation.
ant.ar: عرض السعر الأصلي ماكانش فيه التركيب.

ctx: After our call, we revised the offer. Please find attached the revised quotation with a 10% discount.
ctx_ar: بعد مكالمتنا، عدّلنا العرض. مرفق عرض السعر المعدّل بخصم 10%.
